translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content.text: Yawe, xlrm nzkrka'-krnge x ayzlum natqnge,
Murde tubq-esz'ngrn x angidati-zvzq.
Bzkq ayrplapxq ninge, kxnzawz nem,
Murde trpnzngr leplz mz nrlc kxtubq mz nzobq-krm.
Enqmi rngeng nzmaneutilr ninge x nzrnzbrtiolr ninge mz drtc',
X nzadwatrlr ninge mz nzlo, apux kxbz kx mnclzm mz gq.
Nabznge baonepe,
X talvzo zlwz.
A' amqtrx drtwrnge mz nzaotikr drtwrnge zbq kcng tqvztxpeng.
X dcpx mz drtwrnge da kxnzkctipxng kcng tqalemeng bagr.
Delc tqglalz-ngrbo mqnge bam,
Murde brlxkztitx zlwz drtwrnge nim.
Yawe, ayzlu-anim natqnge murde nabznge baonepe.
Bzkq rlaszq ninge, murde ma tqbzx.
A' pi-zvzm bange mz rngalx kang kqlu kx aodu-zvzq ninge,
Murde abrtrpo drtwrnge bam.
X mailz ninge mz lrpzki kx nao-zlix,
Murde mnc-xgle-zvzx nim.
Yawe, bzkq rlr-ngrbzme mz enqmi rngeng nzlolvz-krdr ninge,
Murde nim me rlakitrx.
Gct rnge, alvztrp bange nzale-krnge me pnz drtwrm.
X rtwayzm bange mz zmrlz ngrm, murde namnc-zpwxx.
Yawe, arlapx ninge da kc tqwai nzpi-krmle murde ma tqbzx.
X tum mz nibrnge mz nzkxpu-krngeng amrlx, murde tubq-esz'ngrn.
Lolvzting enqmi rngeng x milxtxo alo nidr.
Murde aodu-zvzq ninge, kxnzawz nem.
